test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that rectifies the error(s) in the following sentence.

One must do his/her duty proparly.

options.text: One must do once duty proparly.
One must do ones duty properly.
One must do one’s duti proprly.
One must do one’s duty properly.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The possessive form of "one" is "**one’s**," not **"ones**" or **"once."**
 
• "**Duty"** is spelled correctly, and** "proparly"** should be corrected to** "properly."**

Therefore, the correct sentence is: '***One must do one’s duty properly.'***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Using correct **possessive forms **ensures clarity and grammatical accuracy in writing.
 
• Always **double-check spelling** to maintain **professionalism and readability** in written communication.
